div.p: The terms governing your use of BHD Asia services and this website.
Last updated: 8 November 2026 | Business & Human Development Consulting Pte Ltd

These Terms and Conditions govern your engagement with Business and Human Development Consulting Pte Ltd ("BHD Asia", "we", "us", "our"). By booking any of our services, events, or programmes, or by using our website, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions.

"Client" refers to any individual or organisation that engages BHD Asia for services. "Services" includes coaching, consulting, facilitation, training programmes, workshops, and events. "Agreement" means any service agreement, booking confirmation, or contract between BHD Asia and the Client.

All engagements commence upon written confirmation of booking or signing of a service agreement. BHD Asia reserves the right to decline any engagement at its sole discretion. Services are described in the relevant programme or proposal documents provided to the Client.

Fees are as stated in the relevant booking confirmation, programme information, or proposal. All fees are in Singapore Dollars (SGD) unless otherwise stated. Payment is due as specified in the agreement — typically in advance for events and workshops. Online ticket payments are processed securely by Stripe or PayPal. BHD Asia reserves the right to withhold service delivery until payment is received.

Early bird and promotional prices are available for the period specified. Once the deadline has passed, the relevant pricing tier will apply automatically. BHD Asia is not obliged to honour early bird rates after the advertised deadline.
The following policy applies to all events and workshops:

ul.li: All tickets and registration fees are strictly non-refundable and non-cancellable. No refunds will be given for cancellations or non-attendance, regardless of when notice is given.
Substitutions (replacement attendees) are permitted at no additional cost if you tell us in writing at bonjour@bhd-no-spamasia.com at least 48 hours before the event.

div.p: Individual coaching sessions may be rescheduled with at least 24 hours' notice at no charge. Cancellations or rescheduling with less than 24 hours' notice will be charged at the full session rate. Packages and retainers are non-refundable.
div.h2: 7. Event Postponement or Cancellation by BHD Asia
div.p: BHD Asia reserves the right to postpone, reschedule, or cancel events due to insufficient enrolment, force majeure, or other circumstances beyond our control. In such cases, Clients will be offered a transfer to a rescheduled date or a credit of equal value toward a future BHD Asia event or programme. BHD Asia will not be liable for any travel, accommodation, or other costs incurred by participants.

BHD Asia treats all information shared in coaching and consulting engagements as strictly confidential. We will not disclose personal information shared during sessions to any third party without your explicit consent, except where required by law or where there is an immediate risk of harm. Clients are equally expected to maintain confidentiality regarding the coaching process and any shared materials.

All materials, content, programmes, frameworks, and methodologies developed or provided by BHD Asia remain the intellectual property of BHD Asia. Clients may not reproduce, distribute, or use these materials for commercial purposes without prior written consent.

To the fullest extent permitted by law, BHD Asia's liability for any claim arising from our services is limited to the fees paid by the Client for the relevant service, and BHD Asia is not liable for indirect, consequential, or special damages of any kind, including loss of income or loss of business. Nothing in these Terms and Conditions excludes or limits any liability that cannot be excluded or limited under Singapore law, including liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence.

Coaching and consulting are collaborative processes that require active engagement and commitment from the Client. BHD Asia does not guarantee specific outcomes, results, or achievements. Success depends significantly on the Client's own efforts, openness, and commitment to the process.

Participants in TRE™ (Tension and Trauma Releasing Exercises) workshops and other somatic programmes are required to disclose any medical conditions, injuries, or contraindications prior to participation. BHD Asia reserves the right to exclude participants from physical activities if deemed necessary for their safety. Participation is at the Client's own risk.

All participants in BHD Asia events and programmes are expected to behave respectfully and professionally toward other participants, facilitators, and staff. BHD Asia reserves the right to remove any participant whose behaviour is deemed disruptive, discriminatory, or harmful, without refund.

BHD Asia may photograph or record events for promotional and educational purposes. By attending, participants consent to being included in such materials. If you prefer not to be photographed, please notify us in advance. Recording of sessions by participants is not permitted without prior written consent.

Personal data collected in connection with our services is handled in accordance with our Privacy Statement and the Personal Data Protection Act 2012 of Singapore. Please refer to our Privacy Statement for details.

Our website is provided for informational purposes only. BHD Asia makes no warranties regarding the accuracy or completeness of website content. Links to third-party websites are provided for convenience; BHD Asia is not responsible for their content or practices.

BHD Asia shall not be held liable for any failure to perform its obligations due to circumstances beyond its reasonable control, including but not limited to acts of God, natural disasters, pandemics, government restrictions, or technical failures.

BHD Asia reserves the right to amend these Terms and Conditions at any time. Updated terms will be posted on our website. Continued use of our services after amendment constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
If any provision of these Terms and Conditions is found to be unenforceable or invalid, the remaining provisions shall continue in full force and effect.
These Terms and Conditions are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Singapore. Any disputes arising shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Singapore.
For any questions regarding these Terms and Conditions, please contact us at bonjour@bhd-no-spamasia.com or at our registered address: 50 Raffles Place, Singapore Land Tower #30-00, Singapore 048623.
